text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Oooohhh~)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy seemed to have run far better
than the audience had expected.
However...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph... How's that...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Well now, wasn't that fine? Though it's kinda boring that she didn't snap back~.
She's supposed to be our "comic relief."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, what a relief I didn't trip over my words...
If you mess up during a race, you could cause a whole accident on track.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I was looking forward to a “bizarre race” though~
Guess she just ran normally, huh...
Ahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Traineeerrr.
Windy-chan is going back to the waiting room now-noda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hurry up and get over here too~!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ah, Windy-chan,
are you leaving already...?

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text: Even after running such a cool race... I wanted to keep clapping for you for so much longer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The woman who muttered that was clutching a Shinko Windy
plushie to her chest.
choice_data_list: (So there really are people cheering me on...)

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan...
I don't think of you as just comic relief, you know...
You were amazing...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Windy-chan's reputation as a meme character
has really cemented itself, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Setting aside how she runs,
she just naturally hypes everyone up just by being there... you know?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No way... Windy-senpai is running
so well, though...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: She seemed even stronger than when I saw her before...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Their sheer drive shouting, "I want to win!" and "I'll show them!"... I can feel it crackling in the air...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Besides, even in an atmosphere like that,
she gave it everything she had...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Even though I'm about ready to give up.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Even though so many things are being said about you, Senpai...
Even so..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: How can you try so hard...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Phew!
Today, I conquered myself once again!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph, Windy-chan already knows! She knows she's great!
choice_data_list: Shouldn't you have waved to the audience?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That sort of thing is totally fine, nanoda.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'll do stuff like that after my ambitions are realized!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A strong will peered from her eyes.
She must feel it's still too early, as she has yet
to clear her name... That must be her intention.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Right now... nobody sees how strong Windy-chan is, so even if I give fan service to the crowd, they'll just make fun of me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Still...! Windy-chan is definitely gonna
make her ambition come true one day!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: We just have to bear with it until then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If you can be patient... instead of rushing
for a big GⅠ win right now, a stage where you can steadily
showcase your abilities might be better."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It would be best to focus on conditioning for the rest of the year
and kick into high gear after the new year starts.
In that case, the next race shouldn't be a GⅠ, but rather...
choice_data_list: About our next target race, though...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh? Made up your mind already? Let's hear it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmm, Chukyo Racecourse, huh... I heard Aichi has a ton of delicious food♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Sounds good. If my evil chief of staff says so, you must have something in mind.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan's just gonna blast through,
no matter where it is!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after putting on such a strong performance, the public's perception of her remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, her challenge continues.
For now, let's head back to the summer training camp.
